desc: Read the integer N and strings S and T from standard input.
Construct a mapping dictionary where each character in S is mapped to the corresponding character in T at the same index.
Validate the mapping: iterate through the dictionary to ensure no character in S maps to multiple different characters in T. If a conflict is found, print -1 and exit.
Count the number of unique characters in S that are not already equal to their mapped character in T. This count represents the minimum number of operations required.
Detect cycles in the functional graph restricted to characters present in S (considering only edges where $S[i] \to T[i]$ and $S[i] \neq T[i]$).
Calculate the final answer as (count of changing chars) + (number of cycles) and print it.
Write the complete Python solution and output it.
Run the code against provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Test edge cases: $N=1$, strings already identical, strings completely different, cycles of length 2, 3, etc.
